## Notes

- **[MULTI_STACK]**: Two stacks are present. JS/TS (Next.js 16.3.1 App Router, React 19.2.8, TS 5 strict) is primary — the root manifest is `package.json`, confirming JS/TS as the resolved stack profile. SQL/PL-pgSQL (`supabase/migrations/*.sql`, `supabase/tests/*.sql`) is a supporting artifact set (schema, RLS, triggers) consumed by the JS/TS app via `@supabase/ssr`; it is NOT a standalone backend service and this is NOT an Oracle/PL-SQL codebase. Both stacks are itemized in the Background Logic Source Inventory above per stack-independent gap computation.
- **Test/generated content excluded from File Inventory** (scanned for cross-reference awareness, per task instruction to walk `e2e/` and `supabase/tests/`, but excluded as non-source per the template's "non-test" rule):

Considered for the BL `integration` category and deliberately excluded — they are generic SDK bootstrap present in effectively every Supabase+Next.js app, not a distinguishing integration pattern; tagged `other` in File Inventory instead.
- **Server Actions** (`app/sun-kudos/actions/*.ts`, 4 files) are tagged `route` in the File Inventory — Next.js Server Actions are the RPC-style mutation entry points analogous to API routes in this App Router project; there is no `app/api/**` directory in this codebase.
- **`proxy.ts` / `lib/supabase/proxy.ts`** are tagged `permission`, not `middleware`/BL — per `bl-source-patterns.md`, auth/permission middleware is explicitly excluded from the Background Logic inventory and belongs to the permissions template instead.
